Frequently Asked Questions

View all FAQs arrow_forward
How does Field Engage work for vendors?
Field Engage provides a complete platform for vendors to manage work orders, track field teams, automate workflows, and get real-time insights. You can onboard your team, assign tasks, and monitor performance from a single dashboard.
Is there any onboarding or setup fee?
No, there is no onboarding or setup fee. You can start with a free trial and choose a plan that fits your business needs. Our team provides free training and support during onboarding.
How do I get paid?
Payments are processed automatically through our secure payment gateway. You can set up your bank account and choose your payout schedule (weekly, bi‑weekly, or monthly). Invoices and payment history are available in your dashboard.
Can I manage multiple teams or locations?
Yes, Field Engage supports multi‑location and multi‑team operations. You can create different teams, assign roles, and set location‑specific workflows. All data is centralized for easy tracking.
Is training provided for my team?
Absolutely. We offer free training sessions, video tutorials, and documentation for you and your team. Our support team is also available to answer any questions during onboarding.
Who can I contact for support?
You can reach our support team via email (support@fieldengage.com), live chat on the platform, or by submitting a ticket from your dashboard. We typically respond within 24 hours.
